import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    crm_feed = inputs["crm_feed"]
    web_feed = inputs["web_feed"]
    
    # Step 1: Create STG_COMBINED with UNION ALL and source ranking
    crm_with_rank = crm_feed.copy()
    crm_with_rank["src_rank"] = 1
    
    web_with_rank = web_feed.copy()
    web_with_rank["src_rank"] = 2
    
    stg_combined = pd.concat([crm_with_rank, web_with_rank], ignore_index=True)
    
    # Step 2: Apply ROW_NUMBER with deterministic ordering
    # ORDER BY src_rank ASC, updated_at DESC, email ASC
    stg_combined = stg_combined.sort_values(
        by=["customer_id", "src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, True, False, True],
        kind="stable",
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Apply ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id)
    stg_combined["rn"] = stg_combined.groupby("customer_id", sort=False).cumcount() + 1
    
    # Step 3: Filter where rn = 1
    golden = stg_combined[stg_combined["rn"] == 1][["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"golden": golden}
